    Content & Copyright Policy

    1. Your Responsibility
    You're responsible for everything you post — photos, videos, text, and any other content. Only share content you own or have permission to use. Don't post anything that infringes someone else's copyright, contains their personal information without consent, or is otherwise unlawful.

    2. Legal Framework
    Haba operates in South Africa. Content on Haba is governed by the Copyright Act 98 of 1978 and the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 25 of 2002 ("ECT Act"). Section 77 of the ECT Act sets out a formal process — a "take-down notice" — for requesting removal of unlawful content.

    3. How to Report Infringing or Unlawful Content
    You can report a specific post directly in the app: open the ⋮ menu on the post and select "Report Post." To submit a formal take-down notice under Section 77, you can also write to us directly at legal@vynix.co.za and include:

    • Your full name and contact details
    • A description of the content and where it appears in the app
    • Why the content is unlawful (e.g. copyright you own, or personal information posted without consent)
    • A statement that you're acting in good faith and that the information you've provided is true and correct to the best of your knowledge
    • Your signature (a typed full name is sufficient)

    4. What Happens Next
    We aim to act on valid notices within a reasonable time — as a general practice, within a few business days. We may remove or restrict access to reported content and notify the person who posted it, in line with the ECT Act's take-down process.

    5. Repeat Infringement
    Accounts with repeated, confirmed copyright violations may have their posting privileges suspended or their account terminated.

    6. Personal Information
    If a post contains someone else's personal information shared without their consent, this may also fall under the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 ("POPIA"). You can report this the same way as above.

    This policy is provided for information and doesn't constitute legal advice. If you need guidance on your specific situation, please consult a qualified attorney.

    Your direct messages are end-to-end encrypted — only you and the person you're chatting with can read them, not even us. This key lives only on this device, so signing in elsewhere starts fresh with no history. Set a backup PIN to carry your chat history to any new device.
